events.title: Process creation
events.summary: Records a newly created process with extended execution context such as command line, ProcessGuid and configured file hashes.

events.title: A process changed a file creation time
events.summary: Records explicit modification of a file creation timestamp and preserves timing context useful for detecting timestamp manipulation while acknowledging legitimate changes.

events.title: Network connection
events.summary: Records process-associated TCP and UDP network connections with source and destination network context.

events.title: Sysmon service state changed
events.summary: Reports Sysmon service state transitions such as service start and stop.

events.title: Process terminated
events.summary: Records process termination with process identity and UTC timing context.

events.title: Driver loaded
events.summary: Records driver load activity with configured hashes and signature-related information.

events.title: Image loaded
events.summary: Records a module or image being loaded into a process, including process, hash and signature context; collection can be high-volume.

events.title: CreateRemoteThread
events.summary: Records creation of a thread in another process, including source/target process context and available thread start-address/module/function information.

events.title: RawAccessRead
events.summary: Records raw read access to disks or volumes using raw-device paths and identifies the source process and target device.

events.title: ProcessAccess
events.summary: Records one process opening another process, providing telemetry useful for investigating memory access and process-manipulation activity; filtering is important in noisy environments.

events.title: FileCreate
events.summary: Records file creation and overwrite operations, supporting monitoring of persistence, temporary, download and other security-relevant locations.

events.title: RegistryEvent (Object create and delete)
events.summary: Records Registry key and value create/delete operations, useful for monitoring persistence and other configuration changes.

events.title: RegistryEvent (Value Set)
events.summary: Records Registry value modifications and captures written values for supported Registry data types such as DWORD and QWORD.

events.title: RegistryEvent (Key and Value Rename)
events.summary: Records Registry key and value rename operations and the resulting name.

events.title: FileCreateStreamHash
events.summary: Records creation of named file streams and hashes relevant file and stream content, including alternate-data-stream scenarios such as Zone.Identifier.

events.title: ServiceConfigurationChange
events.summary: Records changes to Sysmon configuration, including updates to filtering rules.

events.title: PipeEvent (Pipe Created)
events.summary: Records creation of a named pipe for interprocess communication.

events.title: PipeEvent (Pipe Connected)
events.summary: Records a named-pipe connection between client and server endpoints.

events.title: WmiEvent (WmiEventFilter activity detected)
events.summary: Records WMI event-filter registration with namespace, filter name and expression context.

events.title: WmiEvent (WmiEventConsumer activity detected)
events.summary: Records registration of a WMI event consumer and associated consumer/destination context.

events.title: WmiEvent (WmiEventConsumerToFilter activity detected)
events.summary: Records binding of a WMI consumer to an event filter.

events.title: DNSEvent (DNS query)
events.summary: Records process DNS queries whether successful or failed and whether cached or not; this telemetry is available on supported Windows generations beginning with Windows 8.1.

events.title: FileDelete (File Delete archived)
events.summary: Records file deletion and additionally archives the deleted file in the configured archive directory.

events.title: ClipboardChange (New content in the clipboard)
events.summary: Records changes to system clipboard content.

events.title: ProcessTampering (Process image change)
events.summary: Records detection of supported process-image tampering/hiding techniques such as process hollowing or herpaderp-style behavior.

events.title: FileDeleteDetected (File Delete logged)
events.summary: Records file deletion without archiving the deleted file.

events.title: FileBlockExecutable
events.summary: Records Sysmon detecting and blocking creation of executable PE files under configured policy.

events.title: FileBlockShredding
events.summary: Records Sysmon detecting and blocking file-shredding activity under configured policy.

events.title: FileExecutableDetected
events.summary: Records detection of creation of a new executable PE file.

events.title: Error
events.summary: Reports internal Sysmon errors or conditions that prevented expected work, including heavy-load, implementation, security or integrity-related failures.
